preamble.title: ebecca/amm-dex
preamble.description: A constant-product AMM validator written in Aiken.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

ebecca/dex_types/AssetId.title: AssetId
ebecca/dex_types/AssetId.description:
Shared types for the shared-address AMM, factory, and LP policy.
 ADA is represented by empty policy ID and asset name.

ebecca/dex_types/BootstrapEscrowDatum.title: BootstrapEscrowDatum
ebecca/dex_types/BootstrapEscrowDatum.description:
The escrow moves on-chain from an owner-funded offer to a fully funded
 commitment. Only the Team can turn the funded commitment into a pool.

ebecca/dex_types/BootstrapOfferDatum.title: BootstrapOfferDatum
ebecca/dex_types/BootstrapOfferDatum.description:
An FT owner's invitation to bootstrap an AMM pool with a second liquidity
 provider. pool_lovelace is the exact ADA buffer locked with the FT. For ADA
 pairs it is part of the final ADA reserve; for token/token pairs it is the
 final pool UTxO's min-ADA buffer.

ebecca/dex_types/FactoryDatum.title: FactoryDatum
ebecca/dex_types/FactoryDatum.description:
The factory state is held at the `factory_state` validator. It is consumed
 only to create a pool and is otherwise supplied as a reference input by
 AMM transactions.

anyOf.title: AdvanceBootstrap
anyOf.description: Permissionless only when the factory also consumes bootstrap_offer.

ebecca/dex_types/PoolDatum.title: PoolDatum
ebecca/dex_types/PoolDatum.description:
Every live pool sits at the same AMM script address. `pool_lovelace` is
 the total lovelace locked in the UTxO; it is either the ADA reserve or the
 min-UTxO value for a token/token pair.
